data_section_full_text:
As of April 30, 1999, 90 firms were listed in the New Market. I eliminate
firms that are incorporated outside of Germany (6), listed abroad (5), or
both (5). This restriction reduces the sample to 74 firms but ensures that
all of them trade in the same market and operate in the same legal environment. <sup>20</sup> In addition, I eliminate 5 firms that follow German GAAP in
their annual reports. <sup>21</sup> Thus, the final sample for 1999 contains 69 firms.
